kld.text: Dovin Baan asks the Gatewatch for aid against the renegade threat on Kaladesh but is refused, since the issue is internal to one plane.

Serving Tezzeret, Baan orders gearhulks to isolate Chandra, and when Pia Nalaar surrenders to Consulate custody he hesitantly cooperates in Tezzeret's coup, having been promised leadership of the institution manufacturing the streamlined inventions.
He advises encircling the Aether Hub, names Chandra as the Gatewatch's weakest link, and after hearing Dhiren Baral admit he murdered Kiran, charges him with murder and orders him imprisoned.
When the Renegades attack, Baan infiltrates the airship and crushes the crucial disruptor module of the Hope of Ghirapur before planeswalking away.

clu.text: Dovin Baan orders New Prahv sealed and planeswalker activity reported.
On the set's cards he is an Azorius figure who watches for planeswalker activity.
